name: Super Kawaii Pets

categories.label: Victory Points on Happy (flipped) Animals
categories.labelVi: Điểm các thú đã hạnh phúc
categories.hint: Sum of VP printed on your Animals flipped to their happy side.

categories.label: Victory Points on Locations
categories.hint: Sum of VP printed on Location cards you obtained.

categories.label: Sad Animals left (play and hand)
categories.labelVi: Thú buồn còn lại (trên bàn + trên tay)
categories.hint: -1 point for each sad Animal, including those in hand.

categories.label: Colour majority bonus (optional rule)
categories.labelVi: Thưởng đa số màu (luật tùy chọn)
categories.hint: Optional: 3 points per colour where you have the most horizontal cards (Happy Animals + Locations); 1 each on a tie. Enter total.

tiebreakers.description: Fewest Sad Animals (in play and hand)
If still tied, the win is shared.

notes: family: set-collection. Game ends when a player has 10 horizontal cards (Happy Animals + Locations); finish the round so all have equal turns. Colour majority bonus is an optional rule and is modelled as non-optional-flagged input; leave 0 when not used. Solo mode: win by reaching 10 horizontal cards within the Turns deck, then +3 per colour with at least 5 horizontal cards; ratings 35/40/45/50+ (not modelled).
